import pandas as pd, re
df=pd.read_excel('mixed_units_register.xlsx', sheet_name='Disbursement Register', header=None)
data=df.iloc[5:]
cols=['Record ID','Disbursement Date','Programme','State','Donor / Scheme','Amount','Purpose']
df2=pd.DataFrame(data.iloc[:,0:7].values, columns=cols)
# clean
def parse_amount(v):
    if pd.isna(v):
        return 0
    s=str(v).strip()
    if s=='' or s=='-' or s.upper()=='NA':
        return 0
    # remove ₹ and commas
    s=s.replace('₹','').replace(',','').strip()
    # match number with optional unit
    m=re.match(r'"'^([0-9]*'"\\.?[0-9]+)\\s*([a-zA-Z]*)', s)
    if not m:
        return 0
    num=float(m.group(1))
    unit=m.group(2).lower()
    if unit in ('l','lakh'):
        num*=100000
    elif unit in ('cr','crore'):
        num*=10000000
    elif unit=='k':
        num*=1000
    # also handle 'lakh' spelled
    if 'lakh' in unit:
        num*=100000
    return num
df2['amount_num']=df2['Amount'].apply(parse_amount)
odisha=df2[df2['State']=='Odisha']
nonzero=odisha[odisha['amount_num']"'!=0]
print('"'total odisha', len(odisha))
print('nonzero', len(nonzero))
print(nonzero[['Record ID','Amount','amount_num']].head(20))
\""
